title: Agent 框架与编排
lead: 把模型、工具、状态和人工确认串成一条可执行、可恢复的流程。先想清楚要不要状态机，再决定用哪一层抽象。
who: 适合要把多步任务跑成稳定流程的人；只做单轮问答不用上框架。
choose: 流程有分支、重试、人工确认：先看 LangGraph。
第一次搭多 agent、想快速跑分工：CrewAI 更直观。
想要类型安全、长期维护：Pydantic AI；想要极简代码执行：smolagents。
notFor: 不要为了“多 agent”而多 agent。很多任务一个模型加两个工具就够。
leadEn: Wire models, tools, state and human approval into a workflow that can run, retry and resume. Decide whether you need a state machine before choosing an abstraction.
whoEn: For people turning multi-step tasks into reliable workflows; single-turn Q&A does not need a framework.
chooseEn: Branches, retries and human approval: start with LangGraph.
First multi-agent setup with quick role division: CrewAI is easier to grasp.
Type safety and long maintenance: Pydantic AI; minimal code execution: smolagents.
notForEn: Do not add multiple agents just for the label. Many tasks need one model and two tools.

title: RAG 与知识库
lead: 从文档解析、切分、索引、检索到引用，缺一段都会让答案看起来对、实际不可靠。先定问题，再定语料与评测。
who: 适合有私有文档、需要引用来源的回答场景；公开知识问答不一定要自建 RAG。
choose: 想快速把一套知识库跑起来：RAGFlow 或 Dify。
要自己控检索与生成链路：LlamaIndex / Haystack。
只缺向量检索：Qdrant 生产、Chroma 原型。
notFor: RAG 不是把文档丢进模型。文档质量、权限与更新机制比 chunk size 更重要。
leadEn: Retrieval quality depends on chunking, recall, permissions and evaluation; choose a stack whose sources you can inspect.
whoEn: For teams grounding answers in private documents and needing citations.
chooseEn: Mixed formats and permissions: check parsing, chunking and ACL support first.
Need a ready UI and citations: RAGFlow; code-first pipelines: LlamaIndex.
Measure retrieval separately from generation; keep the source path.
notForEn: Do not use RAG to patch missing source data or unclear permissions.

title: 本地推理与部署
lead: 从单机一条命令，到多卡高吞吐服务，差的是批处理、显存、量化和运维。先按并发与延迟选层，不要一上来就上集群。
who: 适合想把模型跑在自己机器、内网或自有 GPU 上的人；只用 API 的不需要这一节。
choose: 第一次本地跑：Ollama。
Mac / CPU / 边缘：llama.cpp。
生产高吞吐：vLLM 或 SGLang；HF 生态：TGI。
notFor: 本地跑不等于免费。显存、电费、运维和模型更新都要算。
leadEn: Run models on hardware you control: check quantisation, memory fit, concurrency and serving API before choosing.
whoEn: For privacy-sensitive work, offline use or predictable long-running cost.
chooseEn: First local run: Ollama; production serving: vLLM or SGLang.
Mac or small VRAM: check quantised formats and unified memory.
Measure tokens/s and time-to-first-token on your own workload.
notForEn: Do not assume a 7B model replaces a frontier model on hard reasoning.

title: 多模态与图像视频
lead: 图像与视频生成的工具分两层：工作流界面（ComfyUI / WebUI）和代码库（Diffusers）。先看你要创作还是集成。
who: 适合做视觉内容、产品图、视频素材与多模态应用的人；只要文字生成的不需要。
choose: 复杂工作流、可复用节点：ComfyUI。
新手少调参：Fooocus；经典界面：SD WebUI。
要把生成嵌进应用：Diffusers；视频生成：Wan2.1。
notFor: 模型与工作流都有版权和肖像权问题；商用前逐项核对，不能默认可商用。
leadEn: Generate and edit images or video: check model licence, VRAM, input limits and commercial-use terms.
whoEn: For visual content teams that need repeatable pipelines, not one-off prompts.
chooseEn: Image editing with masks: ComfyUI; video generation: check duration and resolution limits.
Review output rights and training-data claims before shipping.
Keep a human review step for faces, text and brand assets.
notForEn: Do not treat a demo output as a production licence.

title: 语音与音频
lead: 语音分识别（ASR）与合成（TTS）两条链。先看语言、实时性、说话人分离和授权，再选模型。
who: 适合会议转写、字幕、配音、语音助手与音频内容生产的人。
choose: 多语言转写基线：Whisper；更快更省：faster-whisper。
中文会议与标点：FunASR；词级时间戳：WhisperX。
中文 TTS：CosyVoice；少样本克隆：GPT-SoVITS（必须授权）。
notFor: 声音克隆不是玩具。没有本人授权，不要克隆、不要冒充、不要商用。
leadEn: Transcribe, synthesise and separate speakers: check language coverage, latency, streaming and data handling.
whoEn: For meeting notes, voice interfaces and audio archives.
chooseEn: Fast local transcription: Whisper variants; streaming: check chunking and VAD.
Speaker labels and timestamps: test on your own recordings.
Voice cloning needs explicit consent and an abuse-review path.
notForEn: Do not upload confidential audio to a service you have not reviewed.

title: 评测与可观测
lead: 上线前要能测，上线后要能看。评测管“答得对不对”，可观测管“为什么慢、为什么贵、哪一步失败”。
who: 适合要把 LLM 应用从 demo 推到生产的人；一次性脚本不需要整套平台。
choose: RAG 回归：Ragas；像单测一样测：DeepEval。
多模型 / 多 prompt 对比：promptfoo。
追踪与成本：Langfuse / Phoenix；上线前红队：Giskard。
notFor: 榜单一分不代表你的场景可用。先建自己的 50–100 条评测集，再谈平台。
leadEn: Measure quality and trace failures: choose tools that record prompts, retrieval, tool calls, latency and cost.
whoEn: For teams shipping agents or RAG and needing regression tests.
chooseEn: Start with a small labelled set and a failure taxonomy.
Trace every step: Langfuse and similar tools; offline scoring: promptfoo.
Track cost and latency beside quality; a score alone is not a release gate.
notForEn: Do not optimise a dashboard before defining what a failure looks like.

title: 训练与微调
lead: 把现成模型改成你自己的：从单卡 QLoRA 到多机 RLHF，先看显存、并行方式与可复现性。
leadEn: Turn a base model into your own: from single-GPU QLoRA to multi-node RLHF, start with VRAM, parallelism and reproducibility.
who: 适合要改模型行为、做领域适配或对齐训练的人；只做推理不用进这个场景。
whoEn: For people who need to change model behavior, adapt to a domain or run alignment training; inference-only work does not need this scene.
choose: 单卡 24GB 想微调 7B：先看 Unsloth。
想把微调流程固化成配置：Axolotl。
做 DPO/PPO/GRPO 对齐：TRL 起步，规模化再看 verl / OpenRLHF。
要训大模型或多机：DeepSpeed、TorchTitan。
MoE 本地跑不动：KTransformers 的专家卸载。
chooseEn: 24 GB single GPU, 7B model: start with Unsloth.
Turn fine-tuning into a reproducible config: Axolotl.
DPO/PPO/GRPO alignment: start with TRL, scale with verl / OpenRLHF.
Large-model or multi-node training: DeepSpeed, TorchTitan.
MoE does not fit locally: KTransformers expert offload.
notFor: 不要为了“全参训练”而全参；多数领域适配 LoRA/QLoRA 就够，先算数据量与评测收益。
notForEn: Do not choose full-parameter training by default; most domain adaptation is served by LoRA/QLoRA. Estimate data volume and eval gain first.
